recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is for core. If spreadsheet profile-on-profile behavior regresses, follow up in the current IG Publisher/tooling repository rather than editing FHIR core specification source.
issue_request: FHIR-13395 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core change request in the FHIR-Tools-IG grouping. It reported that spreadsheet-based IG Publisher output generated a profile intended to derive from US Core Patient as a profile on base Patient instead, because IgSpreadsheetParser used targetProfile rather than profile when selecting StructureDefinition.baseDefinition for a profile-on-profile.
initial_application: The Jira comments record Eric Haas's local fix changing IgSpreadsheetParser.java lines 294-295 from get/hasTargetProfile to get/hasProfile and record preapplication in fhir-svn commit 5064546deb0865ee7d36a88a36e116f69441c863. Git history confirms that commit changed the parser to set baseDefinition from the first differential root type profile when present.
additional_context: FHIR-14313 was applied by the same historical parser commit but concerns StructureDefinition.description metadata support. Later core history removed IG Publisher assets with commit 56ceb0df08dd72381a4f98f1ea4ac5ea6d139a8b, 'Remove IG publisher (it's gone to Maven)', and the remaining Java IG tooling was deleted by 6a5793adde. The current checkout has zero Java source files and no IgSpreadsheetParser implementation to edit. Current profiling narrative still recognizes profiles based on other profiles, and issue-specific Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No FHIR-core source files were changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the requested behavior was applied historically and that any current regression would belong in the current IG Publisher/tooling repository, not this core source checkout.

related_jiras.note: Applied by the same 5064546 IgSpreadsheetParser commit but concerns StructureDefinition.description metadata support rather than profile-on-profile baseDefinition selection.
